card.profile: Border Morris is a collection of individual local dances from villages along the English side of the Wales–England border in the counties of Herefordshire, Worcestershire and Shropshire. They are part of the Morris dance tradition.
card.insight: The Ironmen ( est 1976 ) were another side heavily involved in the 70s revival, their look and style has a more industrial feel and they are one of only two border sides know to dance in clogs.
